title: RISE St. James, Sierra Club sue LDEQ to vacate Hyundai Steel air permit
dek: RISE St. James and the Sierra Club have sued Louisiana's environmental regulator to vacate an air permit for Hyundai Steel, the Sun Herald reports.
summary: According to the Sun Herald, RISE St. James and the Sierra Club have sued the Louisiana Department of Environmental Quality (LDEQ) seeking to vacate an air permit issued for Hyundai Steel. The publisher provided no excerpt, so the grounds of the challenge are not stated.
keyFacts: RISE St. James and Sierra Club are suing LDEQ
The suit seeks to vacate a Hyundai Steel air permit
whyItMatters: Legal challenges to permits can delay or add cost to new US steel projects, including foreign investments made in response to tariffs.
implications: Readers should watch whether the litigation affects the timetable for Hyundai Steel's Louisiana plans; the material does not indicate any impact so far.
